drafted_from: tool:read-business's own row (its words, input schema, sample runs and steps) and what its sample runs answered here; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Read what this account's business took in this month on the payment services it connected", with {"now":"2026-10-15T00:00:00.000Z"}. It runs tool:read-business; its answer contains "October 1".
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Read what this account's business took in this month on the payment services it connected", and give it nothing more: every input is optional. To have each service read with your own account of it, also give held_connections: the names of the connections your vault holds (each {connection_id, fields}, never a value), so tool:read-business asks tool:find-the-account-of-a-service which account to read.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-business and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: The one read of the Business screen (tool:business).
